entities.name: COLLECT (KINESIS DATA STREAMS)
entities.rationale: Primary Amazon Kinesis Data Stream collecting real-time event streams.

entities.name: RULES (KINESIS DATA STREAMS)
entities.rationale: Secondary Amazon Kinesis Data Stream evaluating rules and triggering notifications/stores.

entities.name: NEPTUNE
entities.rationale: Amazon Neptune graph database storing graph network data (50M+ shards).

entities.name: ELASTICSEARCH
entities.rationale: Amazon OpenSearch/Elasticsearch service indexing search data and sending metrics to CloudWatch.

entities.name: CLOUDWATCH
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudWatch receiving metrics/logs from Neptune and Elasticsearch.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: Amazon DynamoDB table receiving state/rule metadata without outgoing arrows.

entities.name: NOTIFICATIONS (SLACK / EMAIL)
entities.rationale: External notification channels (Slack/Email) receiving alerts from Rules stream.

visual_connections.description: Streamed events are passed from collection stream to rules stream.
Ingests high-volume graph entities directly into Amazon Neptune.
Rules processing stream queries and updates relationships in Amazon Neptune.
Evaluated rule outputs and state updates are stored in DynamoDB.
Rules stream triggers alert notifications directly to Slack/Email.
Neptune synchronizes graph entities into Elasticsearch.
Neptune pushes cluster metrics and audit logs to Amazon CloudWatch.
Neptune exports metadata directly into DynamoDB.
Elasticsearch sends index metrics and logs to Amazon CloudWatch.
